lines.en: label beachsix2:
scene amibeachconfront1
: I’m his daughter...not his niece.
lines.zh: 我是他女儿……不是他侄女。

lines.en: : Oh. You are here. That doesn’t make this awkward at all.
lines.zh: 哦。你在啊。这可一点也不尴尬呢。

lines.en: : Ami-
lines.zh: Ami-

lines.en: : Miss Watabe told me you were sorry.
lines.zh: 渡部小姐跟我说你很抱歉。

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront2
: For what?
lines.zh: 为什么抱歉？

lines.en: : Is this really the best time to-
lines.zh: 现在真的是谈这个的好时机吗-

lines.en: : Otoha, you’ve said what you need to say. And I’ll...think about it. But I do appreciate you trying to make my life less shitty even if it is partially for self-motivated reasons.
lines.zh: Otoha，你想说的已经说了。我会……考虑的。不过我确实感谢你试着让我这操蛋的人生好过一点，哪怕有一部分是为了你自己。

lines.en: : Ugh...yeah. Okay. Guess you have {i}another{/i} relationship to mend too.
lines.zh: 唉……是啊。好吧。看来你还有{i}另一段{/i}关系要修补。

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront3
: And sorry for the, uhh...{i}niece{/i} thing, Ami. I still don’t fully understand the...{i}logistics{/i} of the relationship between you guys.
lines.zh: 还有，抱歉提起那个……{i}侄女{/i}的事，Ami。我到现在还是没完全搞懂你们之间的……{i}关系构造{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I’m used to it. And...I heard some of what you were saying about the...Niki situation. So...thank you for that as well. Thank you for caring.
lines.zh: 没关系。我习惯了。而且……我听到了你说的一些……关于 Niki 那件事的话。所以……也谢谢你。谢谢你愿意在乎。

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront4
: It’s not exactly easy to find people who {i}do{/i} anymore.
lines.zh: 现在已经不太容易找到{i}会{/i}在乎的人了。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}it’s definitely something in the water. This entire family is immune to knowing when people like them.
lines.zh: {i}哈……{/i}肯定是水有问题。这一家子全都对「别人喜欢他们」这件事免疫。

lines.en: : Otoha-
lines.zh: Otoha-

lines.en: : Later, Sensei. Stop being a fuck-up and enjoy all of the...daddy issues or whatever.
lines.zh: 以后再说，Sensei。别再当个废物了，好好享受你那堆……爸爸问题还是什么的。

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront5
Otoha hops off the banana boat and I am suddenly thrust into one more sentimental conversation that further delays all of the sex I am going to have today.
lines.zh: Otoha 跳下香蕉船，而我突然又被推进了另一场感伤的对话，进一步推迟了我今天打算做的所有爱做的事。

lines.en: But...I want this more than that. And I feel sick to my stomach for even being able to {i}think{/i} about sex right now when my daughter is within arm’s reach for the first time since she left.
lines.zh: 但是……我更想要这个，而不是那些。而且光是想到{i}性{/i}这件事，我就觉得反胃——毕竟我的女儿自她离开之后，第一次就在我触手可及的地方。

lines.en: Things like that come naturally when you’re conditioned, though. And I’ve been trained with one very specific thing in mind. To devour.
lines.zh: 不过，当你被训练成那样的时候，这种念头来得很自然。而我受过的训练，只冲着一个非常具体的目的：吞噬。

lines.en: : I...picked a pretty bad time to do this, didn’t I?
lines.zh: 我……挑了个挺糟糕的时机来做这件事，是吧？

lines.en: : No, Ami. It’s much better we do this now than nervously sitting around for the entire weekend.
lines.zh: 不，Ami。现在做，比整个周末都紧张兮兮地干坐着要好得多。

lines.en: : Yeah, but...you were clearly having a moment with Otoha and I went and screwed it up. Like I screw up everything else.
lines.zh: 嗯，可是……你刚才明明正在跟 Otoha 说着话，我却跑来搞砸了。就像我搞砸其他所有事一样。

lines.en: : You don’t screw anything up, Ami. You’re-
lines.zh: 你什么都没搞砸，Ami。你-

: I {i}do,{/i} though! I screwed up your moment with Noriko! I screwed up your relationship with Niki! And I screwed up what {i}we{/i} have too when I-

lines.en: : I haven’t even touched myself because I’ve been waiting for {i}you.{/i} And I don’t know if I’ll be able to help myself if we’re in your room.

lines.en: : That...uhh...now? You’re bringing that up {i}now?{/i} Wouldn’t it be better if we just talked about this, like...you know...a {i}normal{/i} family?

lines.en: : Why should we pretend to be something we’re not? The reason we’re in this mess at all is because we’re {i}us.{/i} And that’s anything but normal.
lines.zh: 我们为什么要假装成我们不是的样子？我们陷入这团乱麻，恰恰因为我们是{i}我们自己{/i}。而那跟正常差了十万八千里。

lines.en: : I get that. But if you really feel the way you said you did when we were in your room-
lines.zh: 我明白。但如果你真的像你在你房间里说的那样感觉-

lines.en: : Words won’t help with that. If you really want to understand the way I feel on the inside, there’s a much easier and much more practical way.
lines.zh: 光说话是没用的。如果你真想理解我内心的感受，有个更简单、也更实际的方法。

lines.en: : We need to at least {i}try...{/i}okay? All I ever do is solve my problems with sex, but that’s not really {i}solving{/i} them at all. And I want to be {i}better{/i} with you.
lines.zh: 我们至少得{i}试一试……{/i}好吗？我一向只会用性来解决问题，可那根本不是在{i}解决{/i}。我想在你面前变得{i}更好{/i}。

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront8
I track down Imani on the way to the inn, assuming she’d have my key. Which she {i}did.{/i} And she handed it over no questions asked after seeing who was with me.
lines.zh: 去旅馆的路上我找到了 Imani，猜她应该有我的钥匙。而她{i}确实{/i}有。看到跟我在一起的人是谁之后，她二话没问就把钥匙递给了我。

lines.en: I imagine Wakana told her since {i}I{/i} didn’t.

lines.en: But I don’t think that deeply into whether or not Imani feels somewhat betrayed or let down by this because I have someone else to be concerned about right now.
lines.zh: 但我没有深想 Imani 会不会因此觉得有些被背叛或失望，因为现在我有另一个人要操心。

lines.en: We make it here undetected after that — and find that the room has already been prepped with various welcoming gifts like sodas and snacks and things I likely won’t consume.
lines.zh: 之后我们神不知鬼不觉地到了这里——发现房间里已经备好了各种迎宾礼物，比如汽水、零食，以及一些我大概不会碰的东西。

lines.en: But among these things, there is one object that stands out — a folded sheet of paper with the word “Dad” handwritten across it in red ink.
lines.zh: 但在这些东西里，有一件格外显眼——一张折起来的纸，上面用红笔手写着一个词：「爸爸」。

lines.en: : I asked the front desk if they could put that in here. Don’t read it now, though...it’s kind of embarrassing.
lines.zh: 我让前台帮忙放进去的。不过现在别看……有点难为情。

lines.en: : Another poem?

lines.en: : Something like that.

lines.en: : I’ve had too many...{i}feelings{/i} lately. And I needed to do {i}something{/i} with them before my body exploded.

lines.en: : Maybe next year, me and you can get a room together? And I can handle the cost so you won’t mind if I explode from all of the things you ultimately make me feel.

lines.en: : Maybe just don’t explode in general. This last month or so has taught me that I am effectively helpless without you.

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront10
: I feel like you’ve had a {i}few{/i} opportunities to learn that over the last couple years. I haven’t exactly been emotionally stable for...basically any point of my life with short hair.

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront11

lines.en: : There’s no one I love more than you, Ami.

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront13

lines.en: : So do you just...not care about her at all? Really? After all she’s done to try and make your life better? After all she’s done for {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: 所以你就……一点都不在乎她？真的？在她为了让你生活变好做了那么多之后？在她为{i}我{/i}做了那么多之后？

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront21
: I try not to care about pretty much anyone other than you, Dad. {i}My{/i} feelings don’t matter, so they may as well not even exist.
lines.zh: 除了你，我基本试着不去在乎任何人，爸爸。{i}我的{/i}感受不重要，所以它们干脆不存在好了。

lines.en: : Why wouldn’t your feelings matter? Why would you think that?
lines.zh: 你的感受为什么会不重要？你为什么会这么想？

lines.en: : Because {i}I’m{/i} not the protagonist. I’m the main heroine. And my feelings are little more than set-dressing to make {i}your{/i} journey more fulfilling in the long run.
lines.zh: 因为{i}我{/i}不是主角。我是第一女主角。而我的感受不过是布景，是为了让{i}你{/i}的旅程在长远看来更充实。

lines.en: : Anything {i}I{/i} feel has to be in relation to you. Otherwise, I’ll seem too independent and you’ll fall out of love with me and choose somebody else’s route.
lines.zh: 我{i}所{/i}感受到的一切都必须与你有关。不然我就显得太独立，你就会不再爱我，去选别人的路线。

lines.en: : Can we do this without you pretending to be Molly?
lines.zh: 我们能别让你假装成 Molly 吗？

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront22
: Well, yeah. But that makes sense, doesn’t it? I’ve never lived for myself even a day. Why should I start now when I’m {i}happy{/i} being dependent on you?
lines.zh: 嗯，可以。但这很合理啊，不是吗？我这辈子从来没有为自己活过一天。既然我{i}乐于{/i}依赖你，为什么现在要开始为自己活？

lines.en: : Because that’s not how you grow up.
lines.zh: 因为那不是你长大的方式。

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront23
: I know! So I just {i}won’t{/i} grow up then. That’s what you did, right? This way, I can stay your daughter forever and ever and things will be perfect! We don’t need another girl around.
lines.zh: 我知道！那我就{i}不{/i}长大好了。你不就是这么做的吗？这样我就能永远当你的女儿，一切都会完美！我们不需要另一个女孩在旁边。

lines.en: : You know that part of being a parent is learning, right? And trying to give your child the things {i}you{/i} lacked so that {i}they{/i} come out better in the long run?
lines.zh: 你知道为人父母的一部分是学习，对吧？努力给你的孩子{i}你{/i}曾缺失的东西，好让{i}他们{/i}长远来看变得更好？

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
: Oh, is that why you fuck me all the time? Awesome.
lines.zh: 哦，所以你才老是操我吗？真棒。

lines.en: : That- no. Just...pretend I don’t do that for a second.
lines.zh: 那——不是。就……你先假装我没干那件事。

lines.en: : I don’t want you to be another {i}me,{/i} Ami. I’m a miserable, terrible person with no hope of changing. I am the {i}last{/i} thing I want you to turn into.
lines.zh: 我不想你变成另一个{i}我{/i}，Ami。我是个悲惨又糟糕的人，没有改变的希望。我{i}最{/i}不想你变成的，就是我。

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront24
: Well, {i}I{/i} think you’re amazing. And I don’t think I’ve made a mistake by labeling you as my role model when you’ve made me happier than anyone else ever has.
lines.zh: 可{i}我{/i}觉得你很棒。而且我觉得把你当成我的榜样并没有错，因为你比任何人都让我幸福。

lines.en: : I’ve made you happier than anyone else has because you’ve never given anyone else a shot. Niki was a perfect opportunity for you to learn that.
lines.zh: 我比任何人都让你幸福，是因为你从来没给过别人机会。Niki 本是你学到这一点的绝佳机会。

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront25
: {i}Okay...{/i}sure. But say I {i}do{/i} learn that. And I come to love Niki just as much as I love you. Maybe even {i}more.{/i} Then what? What happens to us? What happens to you?
lines.zh: {i}好吧……{/i}行。但假设我{i}真的{/i}学到了。然后我爱上了 Niki，就像爱你一样。甚至{i}更{/i}爱。那然后呢？我们会变成什么样？你会变成什么样？

lines.en: : Then, in turn, what happens to {i}me{/i} when I lose both sight and grip of the single thing keeping me grounded? Everything changes. Everything falls apart. Everything is scary.
lines.zh: 反过来，当我失去唯一让我脚踏实地的事物的踪影和抓手时，{i}我{/i}又会变成什么样？一切都会变。一切都会崩塌。一切都很可怕。

lines.en: : I can’t...{i}deal{/i} with scary. And {i}you’re{/i} safe. So it’s my natural instinct to do whatever I can to preserve that. Niki was...a virus in the grand scheme of my perfect world.
lines.zh: 我……{i}应付{/i}不了可怕的东西。而{i}你{/i}是安全的。所以我的本能就是不惜一切保住它。Niki 在我那完美世界的宏大蓝图里……是一种病毒。

lines.en: : There is no perfect world, Ami. That’s not a thing.
lines.zh: 没有完美的世界，Ami。那东西不存在。

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront26
: Not yet, it’s not...
lines.zh: 现在还没有……

lines.en: : But {i}one{/i} day.
lines.zh: 但{i}总有{/i}一天。

lines.en: : One day, it’ll be reality. And it’ll be you and me...and everyone else who comes after, but never measures up.
lines.zh: 总有一天，它会成为现实。会是你和我……还有之后来的所有人，但谁都比不上。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I think that’s the only place I can ever be happy. Which is why I...got all upset and angry and sort of...flipped out on you and said a bunch of stuff I didn’t mean.
lines.zh: 有时候，我觉得那是我唯一能幸福的地方。所以我才……那么生气、那么难过，还……对你发了一通火，说了一堆我并不是真心的气话。

lines.en: : I’m...trying really hard, you know. In a lot of ways you won’t ever really understand. But I am. And so I...
lines.zh: 我……真的很努力了，你知道吗。在很多你永远不会真正理解的方式上。但我确实在努力。所以我……

lines.en: : I ask you to overlook and...maybe {i}forgive{/i} me if I ever do anything crazy. Which I probably don’t {i}need{/i} to ask since I know you’ll do it anyway, just...I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我请求你宽恕，并且……也许{i}原谅{/i}我，如果我以后做了什么疯狂的事。虽然我大概{i}不必{/i}开口问，因为我知道你反正都会做，只是……我不知道。

lines.en: : I just don’t want anyone taking my dad away.
lines.zh: 我只是不想有人把我爸爸抢走。

lines.en: : No one’s going to take me away, Ami. I love {i}you{/i} the most, remember?
lines.zh: 没人会把我抢走的，Ami。我{i}最{/i}爱你，记得吗？

lines.en: : Only because I’m the one beside you right now.
lines.zh: 只不过因为现在坐在你旁边的是我。

lines.en: : If Ayane...or Maya...or even Chika was sitting here, I bet you’d tell them the same exact thing because it’s the easiest option. You don’t have to {i}mean{/i} it to say it.
lines.zh: 如果坐在这里的是 Ayane……或者 Maya……甚至是 Chika，我打赌你会对她们说一模一样的话，因为那是最省事的选项。说出口不一定要{i}当真{/i}。

lines.en: : Well, this time I do. And if the whole world disappeared and I only got to bring one person with me to a new one, that person would be you.
lines.zh: 嗯，这次我是当真的。如果整个世界消失，我只能带一个人去新的世界，那个人会是你。

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront27
: I don’t think that’s good for repopulation purposes. But it is good for Ami purposes, so I accept. Even if that’s another lie.
lines.zh: 我觉得这对繁衍人口不太有利。不过对 Ami 很有利，所以我接受。哪怕这又是一句谎话。

lines.en: : I’m going to talk to her, Ami.
lines.zh: 我会去跟她谈的，Ami。

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront28
: What, Niki? Why? We both got what we wanted. If she stays away, {i}you{/i} can’t hurt her anymore and {i}I{/i} don’t wind up wanting her around.
lines.zh: 什么，Niki？为什么？我们都得到想要的了。如果她离得远远的，{i}你{/i}就不能再伤她，{i}我{/i}也不会最后变得想要她在身边。

lines.en: : You’re right. But then {i}she{/i} doesn’t get what she wants. And she is extremely important to me, Ami. So you can see this as...{i}me{/i} growing up, I guess. Or...trying to.
lines.zh: 你说得对。但那样{i}她{/i}就得不到她想要的了。而她对我来说极其重要，Ami。所以你可以把这看成……{i}我{/i}在长大吧。或者……在学着长大。

lines.en: : Can you...okay. How about this — you guys talk. Figure things out. Whatever. But have some {i}other{/i} girl move in if you’re so desperate to give me a mother figure.
lines.zh: 那你能不能……好吧。这样吧——你们谈。把事情理清楚。随便怎样。但如果你真那么急着给我一个母亲形象，就让{i}别的{/i}女孩搬进来。

lines.en: : What? That’s not-
lines.zh: 什么？那不是-

lines.en: : That’s 100%% what it is and you know it. Niki sweet-talked you into thinking I need a mother figure to get by and it’s just not true.
lines.zh: 那 100%% 就是这么回事，你心里清楚。Niki 用甜言蜜语让你相信我需要一个母亲形象才能过下去，而那根本不是真的。

lines.en: : But if it {i}was,{/i} why is Niki a problem but not some other woman?
lines.zh: 但如果{i}是{/i}真的，为什么 Niki 是问题，换个别的女人就不是？

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront29
: Ami-
lines.zh: Ami-

lines.en: : She got a head start...
lines.zh: 她抢跑了……

lines.en: : It’s not fair. It’s the same issue Maya has with her. It’s...harder for us to {i}beat{/i} Niki and win you over in the end. And Niki’s not the type that will ever be okay with your love being...dispersed.
lines.zh: 不公平。这跟 Maya 对她的意见一样。我们{i}很难{/i}在最后{i}赢过{/i} Niki、把你抢到手。而 Niki 是那种永远不会接受你的爱被……分散的类型。

lines.en: : She won’t accept us. And so {i}I{/i} can’t ever accept her. And that’s not even getting into her weird hatred toward incest.
lines.zh: 她不会接受我们。所以{i}我{/i}永远没法接受她。这还没算上她对乱伦那股莫名其妙的憎恨。

lines.en: if amifingered == False:
: If anything, I think society would say your {i}affinity{/i} for it is the weird thing.
lines.zh: 要说的话，我觉得社会会觉得你{i}对乱伦{/i}的偏好才是奇怪的那个。

lines.en: else:
: If anything, I think society would say our {i}affinity{/i} for it is the weird thing.
lines.zh: 要说的话，我觉得社会会觉得我们{i}对乱伦{/i}的偏好才是奇怪的那个。

lines.en: : Who cares about what society thinks? Because {i}you{/i} surely don’t when your entire sexual history centers around defying it.
lines.zh: 谁在乎社会怎么想？{i}你{/i}肯定不在乎，毕竟你的整部性史都围绕着跟社会对着干。

lines.en: : Not {i}all{/i} of my sexual history. Just...most of it.
lines.zh: 也不是{i}全部{/i}性史。只是……大部分。

lines.en: : So, what’s next? You two make up? Niki moves back in and we all just forget about the crazy and dramatic soap opera ending to our last trip here?
lines.zh: 那么下一步呢？你们俩和好？Niki 搬回来，然后我们就把上次来这儿时那个疯狂又狗血的肥皂剧结局全忘掉？

lines.en: : I don’t know what happens next. But if she’s suffering, I really...I can’t stay away.
lines.zh: 我不知道接下来会怎样。但如果她在受苦，我真的……我没办法不闻不问。

lines.en: : I want to. I {i}really{/i} want to. But I can’t.
lines.zh: 我想。我{i}真的{/i}想。但我做不到。

lines.en: : I need both of you. So I will do whatever I have to do to make sure I {i}have{/i} both of you.
lines.zh: 我需要你们两个。所以为了{i}拥有{/i}你们两个，我什么都会做。

lines.en: : And if you try to get in the way of that, I will ground you forever.
lines.zh: 而如果你想妨碍这件事，我就永远禁你的足。

lines.en: : Can you make me a promise at least?
lines.zh: 那你至少能答应我一件事吗？

lines.en: : So long as it doesn’t involve hurting anyone, sure.
lines.zh: 只要不涉及伤害任何人，可以。

lines.en: : If Niki does come back...and starts playing “Mom” again...
lines.zh: 如果 Niki 真的回来了……又开始玩「妈妈」那一套……

lines.en: : Can you ask her to stop trying to “fix” me? To...change the way I feel?
lines.zh: 你能不能让她别再试着「修好」我？别再试图……改变我的感受？

lines.en: if amifingered == False:
: Because I know {i}you{/i} don’t agree with my feelings for you either, but...it’s not her place to tell me who I can and can’t love. And that really pisses me off.
lines.zh: 因为我知道{i}你{/i}也不同感受……呃，也不同意我对你的感情，但……轮不到她来告诉我可以爱谁、不可以爱谁。那真的让我很火大。

lines.en: else:
: Because I’ve managed to keep “us” a secret from her for your sake, but...{i}god{/i} am I always tempted to hit her over the head with the greatest reveal of all time out of spite.
lines.zh: 因为为了你，我一直把「我们」的事对她保密，但……{i}天哪{/i}，我总是忍不住想赌气地给她当头一棒，来个史上最强揭秘。

lines.en: : I’ll talk to her...but I’m not sure if Niki will ever stop trying to “fix” both of us. I imagine it’s more likely we’ll just break her as well.
lines.zh: 我会跟她谈……但我不确定 Niki 会不会停止试图「修好」我们俩。我想更可能的结果是我们把她也弄坏。

lines.en: : That idea is fine too. I am open to breaking Niki.
lines.zh: 那个主意也不错。我乐于把 Niki 弄坏。

lines.en: : Let’s try not to break anyone, okay? Let’s just...be us and...see where things go from here.
lines.zh: 我们尽量别把任何人弄坏，好吗？我们就……做我们自己，然后……看事情会走向哪里。

lines.en: : Okay...
lines.zh: 好吧……

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront30
: Sex now?
lines.zh: 现在做爱？

lines.en: scene black
if amifingered == True:
: No, Ami. I want this conversation to fester inside of your mind for a little while first. And I imagine you’ll immediately forget all of it if I fuck you right now.
lines.zh: 不，Ami。我想让这番对话先在你脑子里发酵一会儿。而且我猜，如果我现在就操你，你立刻就会把它忘得一干二净。

lines.en: : Ugh...but that’s just one more reason I {i}want{/i} to...
lines.zh: 唉……可那恰恰是我{i}想{/i}要的又一个理由……

lines.en: else:
: No, Ami. Sex never.
lines.zh: 不，Ami。永远不做爱。

lines.en: : Mngh! More head-pats then?
lines.zh: 嗯唔！那就多摸摸头？

lines.en: : Depends. You’re not going to cum from them, are you?
lines.zh: 看情况。你不会因此高潮吧？

lines.en: : We won’t know until we try~
lines.zh: 不试试怎么知道~

lines.en: I wrap my arm around her and hold her close for what feels like forever. And {i}I{/i} feel like I’d be okay with it if it was.
lines.zh: 我伸手揽住她，把她紧紧抱住，感觉像是抱了一辈子。而{i}我{/i}觉得，如果真是一辈子，我也愿意。

lines.en: But it’s not...and the day must go on.
lines.zh: 但不是……日子还得继续。

lines.en: So I send her on her way. And I tell her as she leaves to try and keep the location of my room a secret from everyone else as I don’t want to be swarmed just yet.
lines.zh: 于是我送她离开。她走的时候，我嘱咐她尽量别把我的房间位置告诉别人——我还不想被围攻。

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront31
But what I did {i}not{/i} know at the time of me telling her this was that word had already gotten around somehow.
lines.zh: 但在我跟她说这话的时候，我{i}并不{/i}知道的是，消息已经不知怎么传开了。

lines.en: And that today would be {i}extremely{/i} exhausting.
lines.zh: 而今天会{i}极其{/i}累人。

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront32
: Dad! A bunch of my classmates are here to have sex with you again! Where do you want them?!
lines.zh: 爸爸！我的一堆同学又来找你做爱了！你想让她们在哪儿？！

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront33
: What? How? You’ve been gone for five seconds.
lines.zh: 什么？怎么回事？你才走了五秒钟。

lines.en: : {i}No clue! But they’re here and I can’t hold them back!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我也不知道！可她们就在这儿，我拦不住！{/i}

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront34
: Ahh! They’ve breached the entrance! What do I do now?!
lines.zh: 啊！她们突破入口了！我现在该怎么办？！

lines.en: : You’re holding the door open for them...
lines.zh: 是你在替她们把门扶着……

lines.en: : If I can’t have you, someone will! Which isn’t really how that’s normally supposed to go, but it is {i}this{/i} time because Noriko just bribed me with 10,000 yen!
lines.zh: 如果我得不到你，总得有人得到！虽然正常来说不该是这样，但{i}这次{/i}就是这样，因为 Noriko 刚刚用一万日元贿赂了我！

lines.en: : Thanks, Ami! Don’t spend all of it in one place.
lines.zh: 谢啦，Ami！别一次全花光。

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront35
: Uhh...hi? How did you find me? {i}I{/i} didn’t even know where my room was until a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: 呃……嗨？你们怎么找到我的？{i}我{/i}几分钟前才知道自己房间在哪儿。

lines.en: : Unimportant. This room is now a breeding factory, and we are but four young lasses here to bear your children.
lines.zh: 不重要。这个房间现在是一座生育工厂，而我们不过是四个来为你生孩子的年轻姑娘。

lines.en: : At {i}once?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}同时？{/i}

lines.en: : Quite the contrary, Sir! While waiting outside of the door for your conversation with Arborea to come to an end, we realized that four girls at once could shatter the fabric of reality entirely!
lines.zh: 恰恰相反，先生！在你门外等着你和 Arborea 的对话结束时，我们意识到四个女孩同时上，可能会把现实的结构彻底震碎！

lines.en: : So we’ve decided...to set up a little game for you. A...scavenger hunt, of sorts...
lines.zh: 所以我们决定……给你设一个小游戏。算是一种……寻宝游戏……

lines.en: : You, the chosen one, must collect all {i}two{/i} hidden items and exchange them for the ultimate prize!
lines.zh: 你，被选中的人，必须集齐全部{i}两件{/i}隐藏物品，并用来交换终极奖品！

lines.en: : A threesome with Kirin and me! Which I am now gladly open to whenever you like after you sufficiently boned the {i}fuck{/i} out of me down the hall the last time I was here!
lines.zh: 跟 Kirin 和我来一发三人行！上次我在这儿的时候，你在走廊那头把我操得{i}他妈{/i}够呛，之后我现在随时都乐意这么干了！

lines.en: : Romance over! It’s time to party now.
lines.zh: 浪漫结束！现在是派对时间。

lines.en: : Isn’t two items, like...not that much for a scavenger hunt?
lines.zh: 两件物品，是不是……对寻宝游戏来说也太少了吧？

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront36
: Aye, Sir. But if we added any more, there might not be enough time to get to all of us.
lines.zh: 是的，先生。但要是再加，可能就没足够时间轮到我们所有人了。

lines.en: : Keeping the numbers low ensures that we all get ample time with you...And Kirin seemed really excited to finally do it with Noriko, so...
lines.zh: 把数量压低能确保我们每个人都有充足的时间陪你……而且 Kirin 看起来真的很期待终于能和 Noriko 一起，所以……

lines.en: : I have been waiting for this moment since she and I moved into a room together. And I refuse to let more than two other girls ruin that for me.
lines.zh: 从她和我在一起住进一个房间起，我就在等这一刻。我绝不让两个以上的女孩来毁掉它。

lines.en: : So...what do I do now? Just...go find these “hidden items” and...exchange them for sex with Sana and Molly first?
lines.zh: 那么……我现在该做什么？就……去找那些「隐藏物品」，然后……先用来换跟 Sana 和 Molly 做爱？

lines.en: scene amibeachconfront37
: There actually...aren’t any items at all...we just want you to come have sex with us...
lines.zh: 其实……根本没有任何物品……我们只是想让你来跟我们做爱……

lines.en: : ‘Tis right, Sir. {i}We{/i} are the items. And you must find {i}us!{/i} In various locations on the beach that we will shortly inform you of!
